# Chibueze Felix Anyanwu

> Senior engineer with 7+ years across Android and backend. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and
> Flutter on the client; Go, Java and Spring Boot on the server. Specialises in fintech,
> EMV payments and POS systems. Open to senior Android and backend roles, remote worldwide.

## Summary

Chibueze Felix Anyanwu (also written Chibueze Felix) works on both sides of the API. On the
client: Android applications in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, plus Flutter. On the server: Go
and Spring Boot services, REST and gRPC APIs, PostgreSQL. His specialism is payments — EMV
contact and contactless flows, NFC, POS terminal SDKs, settlement and reconciliation, and the
offline and retry handling that payment systems need. He also builds LLM-backed features into
mobile products and the services behind them.

## Skills

- Android and mobile: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Coroutines and Flow, Flutter, Dart, Java, React Native
- Backend and services: Go, Java, Spring Boot, REST, gRPC, microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues, Docker, Firebase
- Payments: EMV contact and contactless, NFC, POS terminal SDKs, card tokenization, ISO 8583, settlement and reconciliation, offline queues
- AI: LLM API integration, prompt and tool design, RAG-backed features, on-device inference
- Practice: clean architecture, MVI/MVVM, modularisation, testing, CI/CD, observability, Play Store releases

## Hiring

Open to senior Android engineer, backend engineer, mobile lead, fintech engineering and
forward-deployed engineer roles, plus contract work on payments integrations, backend services
and mobile AI features.
